Usage: jsn <command> [options]

Command-line interface for ServiceNow

COMMON COMMANDS
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  incidents  List, show, create, or update incidents
  requests   Work with requested items
  tasks      Work with catalog tasks
  changes    Work with change requests
  approvals  List, approve, or reject approval requests
  knowledge  Search and read knowledge articles
  records    Query any table when no specialized command fits
  setup      Connect to ServiceNow and manage profiles
  discover   Find commands by task word or table

EXAMPLES
  jsn incidents list --query "active=true" --limit 5
  jsn records list --table incident --limit 5 --json
  jsn discover catalog

FLAGS
  -i, --instance  ServiceNow instance URL [string]
  -p, --profile   Configuration profile to use [string]
  --json          Output in JSON format (shortcut for --format=json) [boolean]
  --help          Show help [boolean]

MORE
  jsn <command> <action> --help  Options for one command or action
  jsn discover <word>            Find commands by task words
  jsn discover --table <table>   Find commands configured for a table
  jsn --all-commands --help      Every registered command and global flag
  jsn --json                     Registered command surface as JSON
